# MakeTransformations with Python's needsTransformerForType: integer- and
# bool-strings, and unions containing them. An enum in such a union is
# parsed, not matched (it is not transformed itself).
builder prov stm=date,time,date-time,uuid,integer-string,bool-string
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
prim nul null
prim is integer-string n=IntString
prim bs bool-string n=BoolString
enum e red,green n=Color
union u1 is,nul n=MaybeIntString
union u2 is,i n=IntOrIntString
union u3 bs,e,i n=WithEnum
union u4 is,bs,nul n=Both
cls top a:is,b:bs,c:u1,d:u2,e:u3,f:u4 n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
maketx python debugtx
gc
print
xf 3
xf 6

# Python supports both number kinds: an integer|double union is not
# conflated by flattening (port of test/unit/python-union-order.test.ts,
# type graph part).
builder
prim i integer
prim d double
uunion u n=TopLevel
members u i,d
cls top v:u n=Top
top Top top
finish
flatten
print
maketx python
